"""User activity notification dispatcher."""
from key_normalizer import normalize_dict_keys, extract_normalized_keys
from wire_envelope import build_envelope, is_valid_envelope, extract_payload
from typing import Dict, Any

def dispatch_user_activity(data: Dict[str, Any], epoch_ms: int, service_name: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Dispatch user activity record to notification bus."""
    normalized_data = normalize_dict_keys(data)
    envelope = build_envelope(service_name, epoch_ms, normalized_data)
    return envelope

def broadcast_activity_update(data: Dict[str, Any], epoch_ms: int, service_name: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    msg = dispatch_user_activity(data, epoch_ms, service_name)
    if not is_valid_envelope(msg):
        raise ValueError("Wire envelope failed schema ingestion validation")
    _ = extract_normalized_keys(data)
    return msg
